description.cs: Spoj deset různých zájmů do jedné dohody.
description.en: Join ten different interests into one accord.
Hold the whole until it decides.
Set down what you do not have to carry.

description.cs: Napiš pravidla jasně, aby se nedala obejít.
description.en: Write the rules clearly enough that they cannot be dodged.

description.cs: Ochraň místo před přestavbou k obrazu silnějšího.
description.en: Protect a place from being rebuilt in the stronger's image.
Block the reading that would harm the weaker.

description.cs: Urči pořadí, aby se cesta nezablokovala.
description.en: Set the order so the road does not jam.

description.cs: Nech projít i toho, kdo jede pomalu.
description.en: Let through even the one who travels slowly.
Ensure the way back as well.
Divide the stores without favour.

description.cs: Zvaž, kdo potřebuje víc, ne kdo žádá hlasitěji.
description.en: Weigh who needs more, not who asks louder.
Feed the last one in the queue.

description.cs: Zaveď praxi, která funguje bez dohledu.
description.en: Establish a practice that works unwatched.

description.cs: Ovz, že se to opravdu dodržuje.
description.en: Check that it is actually followed.

description.cs: Nech praxi žít i po svém odchodu.
description.en: Let the practice live after you leave.
Record an event without embellishment.

description.cs: Napiš do záznamu i svou chybu.
description.en: Put your own mistake in the record.

description.cs: Otevři archiv tomu, kdo ho potřebuje.
description.en: Open the archive to whoever needs it.

description.cs: Ptej se místních dřív, než rozhodnete.
description.en: Ask the locals before you decide.

description.cs: Nech poslední slovo těm, kdo tam žijí.
description.en: Leave the last word to those who live there.

description.cs: Zůstaň, i když rozhodnou proti tobě.
description.en: Stay even when they decide against you.

description.cs: Uvolni cestu i pro malého hráče.
description.en: Keep the road open for the small player.
Let someone smaller go ahead of you.
Do not stop the flow even when you are in a hurry.

description.cs: Svol obě strany k jednomu stolu.
description.en: Call both sides to one table.

description.cs: Najdi větu, se kterou odejdou oba.
description.en: Find the sentence both can leave with.
Bring them back when they walk out.

description.cs: Najdi mez dřív, než ji najde provoz.
description.en: Find the limit before production does.

description.cs: Zatíž opatrně a sleduj, co praská.
description.en: Load carefully and watch what cracks.

description.cs: Nech systém vydýchat, než zkusíš znovu.
description.en: Let the system breathe before you try again.

description.cs: Ochraň to, co jinde nemá zastoupení.
description.en: Protect what has no substitute elsewhere.

description.cs: Nech být to, co neumíš obnovit.
description.en: Leave alone what you cannot restore.
Record what is disappearing.
Correct the map that no longer lies.

description.cs: Odvolej omyl, i když jsi ho napsal ty.
description.en: Retract an error even if you wrote it.

description.cs: Uč se dál, i když jsi učil.
description.en: Keep learning even after you taught.
Record the state, not the impression.

description.cs: Dosvědč škodu, kterou by nikdo neuznal.
description.en: Attest harm that would go unacknowledged.

description.cs: Vrať aspoň část toho, co se ztratilo.
description.en: Return at least part of what was lost.

description.cs: Zpomal systém, aby stihl i pomalejší.
description.en: Slow the system so the slower one keeps up.
Wait for whoever fell behind.
Hold a tempo that drowns no one.

description.cs: Měř čas v tisících let, ne v dnech.
description.en: Measure time in millennia, not days.
Do not speed a decision with pressure.
Protect a decision from haste.

description.cs: Předej myšlenku bez nároku na vlastnictví.
description.en: Pass on an idea with no claim of ownership.

description.cs: Nezůstávej, ale neznič, co jsi přinesl.
description.en: Do not stay, but do not destroy what you brought.

description.cs: Nech to růst i bez tebe.
description.en: Let it grow without you.
Join two islands without dominion.
Open the harbour to foreign ships too.
Form an alliance without rewriting either's rules.

description.cs: Řekni pravdu o tom, kam až voda dojde.
description.en: Tell the truth about how far the water reaches.

description.cs: Ochraň to, co by voda vzala.
description.en: Protect what the water would take.

description.cs: Naplánuj ústup dřív, než bude pozdě.
description.en: Plan the retreat before it is too late.

description.cs: Nic nedělej pět minut a vydrž to.
description.en: Do nothing for five minutes and endure it.
Breathe until the panic shrinks.
Decide afterwards, not during.

description.cs: Uzavři, co je hotové, a pojmenuj to.
description.en: Close what is finished and name it.
Pass the torch before it goes out.
Bow and leave.
Align the tempo of the whole group.

description.cs: Najdi, podle čeho se počítá čas.
description.en: Find what time is counted by.

description.cs: Drž soulad, i když se názory rozejdou.
description.en: Keep accord even when views diverge.
Space out effort so it lasts.
Rest before you need to.
Last long, not fast.
Confirm a decision together with another.

description.cs: Rozděl role tak, aby se nikdo neopakoval.
description.en: Split roles so no one duplicates another.
Never decide alone.

description.cs: Popiš, co chceš udělat, jednou větou.
description.en: Describe what you want to do in one sentence.
Take the first concrete step.

description.cs: Zopakuj to i v obyčejný den.
description.en: Repeat it on an ordinary day.

description.cs: Uchovej klíč tak, aby ho nikdo nenašel.
description.en: Keep a key where no one can find it.
Do not tell a thing that is not yours.
Clean up the traces of your work.
Teach someone what you know.
Pull the other up, not yourself.
Value teaching, not competing.

description.cs: Proměň staré řešení v něco, co drží.
description.en: Transform an old solution into something that holds.
Clean it, do not demolish it.
Build the new on the old foundation.
Call the diverse to one table.

description.cs: Rozděl mandát podle práce, ne podle jména.
description.en: Assign mandate by work, not by name.
Give everyone an equal voice.

description.cs: Zapiš si, co si nechceš pamatovat veřejně.
description.en: Write down what you do not want remembered publicly.
Do not publish what belongs only to you.

description.cs: Nech smazat, o co někdo požádá.
description.en: Let be deleted what someone asks to delete.
Close the circle of twelve.
Open the thirteenth step.

description.cs: Ukaž cestu dál a zůstaň vzadu.
description.en: Point the way on and stay behind.
Rest until you are truly rested.

description.cs: Ošetři se dřív, než půjdeš dál.
description.en: Treat the wound before you go on.

description.cs: Vrať se silný, ne jen rychlý.
description.en: Return strong, not merely quick.
Ask before you decide.
Find out both versions of the same story.
Decide and write down why.
Hold together what is falling apart.

description.cs: Odraž výpadek dřív, než zastaví ostatní.
description.en: Avert the outage before it stops everyone.
Let the system run and do not interfere.
Divide the reward without loss of dignity.

description.cs: Chraň to, co nemá být vidět.
description.en: Protect what should not be seen.
Stand by your share.

description.cs: Slož slib, který bude něco stát.
description.en: Make a promise that will cost something.
Pay the price and do not complain.

description.cs: Dodrž i to, co se už nehodí.
description.en: Keep it even when it is no longer convenient.
Make a tool that helps.
Write instructions people understand.
Tend to whoever needs it.
Fill the common stores.
Calm a dispute over resources.
Share even with those who do not need it.
Warn before it is late.

description.cs: Roztřiď, co hoří a co počká.
description.en: Sort what is on fire from what can wait.
Admit what you missed.

description.cs: Ukaž, co umíš, ne kdo jsi.
description.en: Show what you can do, not who you are.
Cover for the missing member of the team.

description.cs: Nauč druhé to, co umíš ty.
description.en: Teach others what you can do.
Walk carefully when you cannot see far.
Take only the next step.

description.cs: Přejdi mezi světy a neztratit se.
description.en: Cross between worlds without getting lost.

description.cs: Začni den i po špatné noci.
description.en: Begin the day even after a bad night.

description.cs: Udělej nejtěžší věc v plné síle.
description.en: Do the hardest thing at full strength.
Pass through the dark without stopping.
Join two administrations into one.
Hold the border so it does not break.
Watch what you joined.

description.cs: Zapiš, co se stalo, bez výkladu.
description.en: Record what happened, without interpretation.

description.cs: Ověř číslo, než ho pustíš dál.
description.en: Verify the number before you pass it on.

description.cs: Uchovej záznam tak, aby ho šel najít.
description.en: Keep the record so it can be found.

description.cs: Svol oslavu, na kterou může každý.
description.en: Hold a feast anyone may attend.

description.cs: Zahraj někomu, kdo si to neumí zařídit.
description.en: Play for someone who cannot arrange it themselves.

description.cs: Pozvi i toho, koho ostatní přehlédli.
description.en: Invite whoever the others overlooked.
Deduct what was taken.
Explain why it was necessary.

description.cs: Nech vychladnout dřív, než se vrátíš.
description.en: Let it cool before you return.

description.cs: Vytvoř vzor, podle kterého jde opravovat.
description.en: Create a pattern that can be repaired by.
Lay the foundation so it holds.

description.cs: Oprav podle vzoru, ne od oka.
description.en: Repair by the pattern, not by eye.

description.cs: Zvaž, co s sebou opravdu potřebuješ.
description.en: Weigh what you actually need to carry.
Make sure nothing is lost.
Leave prepared, not surprised.

description.cs: Hlasuj tak, aby tě nikdo nenutil.
description.en: Vote so that no one can pressure you.
Resist pressure and reveal no source.
Publish the result honestly and in full.
Check what holds the service up from below.
Renew what wore out.

description.cs: Udrž to v chodu, i když to nikdo nevidí.
description.en: Keep it running even when no one looks.
Maintain the system while everyone sleeps.

description.cs: Zaznamenej, co se v noci změnilo.
description.en: Record what changed overnight.

description.cs: Předej stav ráno a beze ztrát.
description.en: Hand over the state in the morning without loss.
